blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the real roots of the following functions correct to 3 decimal places using the bisection method, within the specified interval of sign change. \(f(x) = x^2\sin(x) - 1\) : \([1, 2]\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bisection ka sawal hai. Interval \([1, 2]\) pehle se diya hua hai, is liye humein sirf yeh dekhna hai ke dono siron par sign alag hai ya nahin.
Function \(f(x) = x^2\sin x - 1\) hai aur root 3 decimal places tak chahiye.
Rule: LRT; continuous function ka sign badle to beech mein root zaroor hai.
Plan: midpoint nikalte jayein, har dafa sign change wala aadha rakhein, jab tak \(|f(c)| < 0.0005\) na ho jaye.
Aakhir mein round karein aur \(\pm 0.0005\) par sign dekh kar tasdeeq karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = x^2\sin(x) - 1\), interval \([1, 2]\).
Maloom karna: root jo 3 decimal places tak sahi ho.
Tareeqa: bisection method. Is ki do shartein hain: function continuous ho aur interval ke dono siron par us ka sign alag ho. Phir hum har dafa interval ko beech se do hisson mein kaat-te hain aur sirf woh aadha rakhte hain jis mein sign badal raha ho, kyunke root wahin chhupa hai. 3 decimal places ke liye tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.0005\) hai, aur beech ki values 4 decimals tak rakhenge. Calculator radian mode mein rakhein, kyunke \(\sin x\) mein \(x\) radians mein hai. Degree mode mein \(\sin 1\) bilkul ghalat aata hai.

Continuity aur sign change check karein
\[f(1) = 1^{2}\sin 1 - 1\]\[= 0.8415 - 1 = -0.1585\]\[f(2) = 2^{2}\sin 2 - 1\]\[= 3.6372 - 1 = 2.6372\]
\(f(1)\) negative aur \(f(2)\) positive hai, yani \(f(1)\,f(2) < 0\).
Kyun: \(f\) continuous functions (polynomial, sine, cosine) se bana hai, is liye poore interval par continuous hai; graph mein koi toot nahin. Jab graph neeche se upar jaye aur toote nahin to woh x-axis ko kahin na kahin zaroor kaatega. Yahi Location of Root Theorem (LRT) hai.

Iteration 1: \(a = 1,\ b = 2\)
\[c = \dfrac{1 + 2}{2} = 1.5\]\[f(1.5) = (1.5)^{2}\sin(1.5) - 1\]\[= 1.2444 > 0\]
Root ab \([1, 1.5]\) mein hai, is liye \(b = c\) rakhenge.
Kyun: midpoint \(c\) par function ka sign wahi hai jo \(b\) par tha (positive), is liye \(b\) ki jagah ab \(c\) aa jata hai; sign ka badalna ab \(a\) aur \(c\) ke beech hai. Har iteration ke baad interval aadha reh jata hai.

Iteration 2: \(a = 1,\ b = 1.5\)
\[c = \dfrac{1 + 1.5}{2} = 1.25\]\[f(1.25) = (1.25)^{2}\sin(1.25) - 1\]\[= 0.4828 > 0\]
Root ab \([1, 1.25]\) mein hai, is liye \(b = c\) rakhenge.
Kyun: midpoint \(c\) par function ka sign wahi hai jo \(b\) par tha (positive), is liye \(b\) ki jagah ab \(c\) aa jata hai; sign ka badalna ab \(a\) aur \(c\) ke beech hai. Har iteration ke baad interval aadha reh jata hai.

Isi tarah aage barhte jayein (table)
Iteration 3 se 12 tak wahi do kaam dohraye gaye hain: midpoint nikalo, aur woh aadha rakho jis mein sign badal raha hai. Saari iterations neeche table mein hain (bracket mein \(c\) par \(f\) ka sign likha hai).
Kyun: har step interval ko aadha karta hai, is liye \(k\) steps ke baad interval ki lambai \(\frac{1}{2^{k}}\) reh jati hai; root har dafa zyada tang jagah mein qaid hota jata hai.

Rukna kab hai
\[|f(1.0683)| = 0.0002 < 0.0005\]Is liye \(c = 1.0683\) kaafi qareeb hai. 3 decimal places tak round karne se \(x \approx 1.068\).
Kyun: 8.3.1 ka tolerance rule \(n = 3\) ke liye \(|f(c)| < 0.0005\) maangta hai, aur yeh shart ab poori ho gayi.
Dhyan dein: rounding aakhir mein karein, beech mein nahin.

Tasdeeq:
\[f(1.0675) = -0.0018\]\[f(1.0685) = 0.0007\]Dono ke sign ulte hain, is liye LRT ke mutabiq asal root 1.0675 aur 1.0685 ke darmiyan hai, aur is darmiyan ka har number round ho kar 1.068 hi banta hai. Yani hamara jawab pakka 3 decimal places tak sahi hai.

blocks.text: Answer key ki numbering: "Answers 8.2" mein teeno sawal 1., 2., 3. ki bajaye 2., 3., 4. likhe gaye hain. "2." ke neeche wale jawab (1.068, 0.605, 1.929, 2.613) asal mein isi Question 1 ke hain.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the real roots of the following functions correct to 3 decimal places using the bisection method, within the specified interval of sign change. \(f(x) = 3x - \cos x - 1\) : \([0, 1]\)
blocks.explanation:
Phir bisection ka sawal, interval \([0, 1]\) diya hua hai.
Function \(f(x) = 3x - \cos x - 1\) hai; \(\cos x\) ki wajah se calculator radian mode mein hona chahiye.
Find karna hai root 3 decimal places tak.
Plan: midpoints nikalte jayein jab tak \(|f(c)| < 0.0005\) na ho, phir round karein.
Is sawal mein answer key ki value bhi check karenge, kyunke woh sahi nahin hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = 3x - \cos x - 1\), interval \([0, 1]\).
Maloom karna: root jo 3 decimal places tak sahi ho.
Tareeqa: bisection method. Is ki do shartein hain: function continuous ho aur interval ke dono siron par us ka sign alag ho. Phir hum har dafa interval ko beech se do hisson mein kaat-te hain aur sirf woh aadha rakhte hain jis mein sign badal raha ho, kyunke root wahin chhupa hai. 3 decimal places ke liye tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.0005\) hai, aur beech ki values 4 decimals tak rakhenge. Yahan bhi \(\cos x\) hai, is liye radian mode zaroori hai.

Continuity aur sign change check karein
\[f(0) = 0 - \cos 0 - 1\]\[= 0 - 1 - 1 = -2\]\[f(1) = 3 - \cos 1 - 1\]\[= 3 - 0.5403 - 1 = 1.4597\]
\(f(0)\) negative aur \(f(1)\) positive hai, yani \(f(0)\,f(1) < 0\).
Kyun: \(f\) continuous functions (polynomial, sine, cosine) se bana hai, is liye poore interval par continuous hai; graph mein koi toot nahin. Jab graph neeche se upar jaye aur toote nahin to woh x-axis ko kahin na kahin zaroor kaatega. Yahi Location of Root Theorem (LRT) hai.

Iteration 1: \(a = 0,\ b = 1\)
\[c = \dfrac{0 + 1}{2} = 0.5\]\[f(0.5) = 3(0.5) - \cos(0.5) - 1\]\[= -0.3776 < 0\]
Root ab \([0.5, 1]\) mein hai, is liye \(a = c\) rakhenge.
Kyun: midpoint \(c\) par function ka sign wahi hai jo \(a\) par tha (negative), is liye \(a\) ki jagah \(c\) aa jata hai; sign ka badalna ab \(c\) aur \(b\) ke beech hai. Har iteration ke baad interval aadha reh jata hai.

Iteration 2: \(a = 0.5,\ b = 1\)
\[c = \dfrac{0.5 + 1}{2} = 0.75\]\[f(0.75) = 3(0.75) - \cos(0.75) - 1\]\[= 0.5183 > 0\]
Root ab \([0.5, 0.75]\) mein hai, is liye \(b = c\) rakhenge.
Kyun: midpoint \(c\) par function ka sign wahi hai jo \(b\) par tha (positive), is liye \(b\) ki jagah ab \(c\) aa jata hai; sign ka badalna ab \(a\) aur \(c\) ke beech hai. Har iteration ke baad interval aadha reh jata hai.

Isi tarah aage barhte jayein (table)
Iteration 3 se 11 tak wahi do kaam dohraye gaye hain: midpoint nikalo, aur woh aadha rakho jis mein sign badal raha hai. Saari iterations neeche table mein hain (bracket mein \(c\) par \(f\) ka sign likha hai).
Kyun: har step interval ko aadha karta hai, is liye \(k\) steps ke baad interval ki lambai \(\frac{1}{2^{k}}\) reh jati hai; root har dafa zyada tang jagah mein qaid hota jata hai.

Rukna kab hai
\[|f(0.607)| = 0.0004 < 0.0005\]Is liye \(c = 0.607\) kaafi qareeb hai. 3 decimal places tak round karne se \(x \approx 0.607\).
Kyun: 8.3.1 ka tolerance rule \(n = 3\) ke liye \(|f(c)| < 0.0005\) maangta hai, aur yeh shart ab poori ho gayi.
Dhyan dein: rounding aakhir mein karein, beech mein nahin.

Tasdeeq:
\[f(0.6065) = -0.0021\]\[f(0.6075) = 0.0014\]Dono ke sign ulte hain, is liye LRT ke mutabiq asal root 0.6065 aur 0.6075 ke darmiyan hai, aur is darmiyan ka har number round ho kar 0.607 hi banta hai. Yani hamara jawab pakka 3 decimal places tak sahi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein 0.605 likha hai, jo 3 decimal places tak sahi nahin: \(f(0.605) = -0.0075\), jab ke tolerance 0.0005 hai. Yeh value tab aati hai jab koi iteration 8 (\(c = 0.6055\)) par jaldi ruk jaye. Sahi root \(x \approx 0.607\) hai (zyada theek 0.60710).

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Find the real roots of the following functions correct to 3 decimal places using the bisection method, within the specified interval of sign change. \(f(x) = x^4 - 2x - 10\) : \([1, 2]\)
blocks.explanation:
Bisection ka sawal hai aur function polynomial hai: \(f(x) = x^4 - 2x - 10\), interval \([1, 2]\).
Root 3 decimal places tak chahiye, yani tolerance 0.0005.
Khaas baat: root ke qareeb graph bohat tez charhta hai, is liye \(c\) ke 5 decimals rakhne parenge.
Plan: sign change check, phir midpoints, phir rukna, round karna aur tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = x^4 - 2x - 10\), interval \([1, 2]\).
Maloom karna: root jo 3 decimal places tak sahi ho.
Tareeqa: bisection method. Is ki do shartein hain: function continuous ho aur interval ke dono siron par us ka sign alag ho. Phir hum har dafa interval ko beech se do hisson mein kaat-te hain aur sirf woh aadha rakhte hain jis mein sign badal raha ho, kyunke root wahin chhupa hai. 3 decimal places ke liye tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.0005\) hai, aur beech ki values 5 decimals tak rakhenge. Is sawal mein hum \(c\) ke 5 decimals rakhenge, 4 nahin; wajah neeche wale step mein samjhai hai.

Continuity aur sign change check karein
\[f(1) = 1 - 2 - 10 = -11\]\[f(2) = 16 - 4 - 10 = 2\]
\(f(1)\) negative aur \(f(2)\) positive hai, yani \(f(1)\,f(2) < 0\).
Kyun: \(f\) continuous functions (polynomial, sine, cosine) se bana hai, is liye poore interval par continuous hai; graph mein koi toot nahin. Jab graph neeche se upar jaye aur toote nahin to woh x-axis ko kahin na kahin zaroor kaatega. Yahi Location of Root Theorem (LRT) hai.

Yahan 5 decimals kyun?
Root ke qareeb \(f'(x) = 4x^3 - 2 \approx 27\) hai, yani graph bohat tez (steep) hai. Agar \(c\) mein sirf 0.0001 ka farq aaye to \(f(c)\) taqreeban 0.0027 badal jata hai, jo hamari tolerance 0.0005 se bara hai. Sirf 4 decimals rakhein to method 1.9294 (\(f = -0.0012\)) aur 1.9295 (\(f = 0.0015\)) ke darmiyan atak jata hai aur test kabhi poora nahin hota.
Kyun: kitab ka calculator rule kehta hai kam az kam \(n + 1\) decimals; tez function ke liye ek decimal aur barha lena samajhdari hai.
Dhyan dein: yeh ghalti exam mein aam hai; agar table mein ek hi value baar baar aaye to samajh lein decimals kam hain.

Iteration 1: \(a = 1,\ b = 2\)
\[c = \dfrac{1 + 2}{2} = 1.5\]\[f(1.5) = (1.5)^{4} - 2(1.5) - 10\]\[= -7.9375 < 0\]
Root ab \([1.5, 2]\) mein hai, is liye \(a = c\) rakhenge.
Kyun: midpoint \(c\) par function ka sign wahi hai jo \(a\) par tha (negative), is liye \(a\) ki jagah \(c\) aa jata hai; sign ka badalna ab \(c\) aur \(b\) ke beech hai. Har iteration ke baad interval aadha reh jata hai.

Iteration 2: \(a = 1.5,\ b = 2\)
\[c = \dfrac{1.5 + 2}{2} = 1.75\]\[f(1.75) = (1.75)^{4} - 2(1.75) - 10\]\[= -4.1211 < 0\]
Root ab \([1.75, 2]\) mein hai, is liye \(a = c\) rakhenge.
Kyun: midpoint \(c\) par function ka sign wahi hai jo \(a\) par tha (negative), is liye \(a\) ki jagah \(c\) aa jata hai; sign ka badalna ab \(c\) aur \(b\) ke beech hai. Har iteration ke baad interval aadha reh jata hai.

Isi tarah aage barhte jayein (table)
Iteration 3 se 12 tak wahi do kaam dohraye gaye hain: midpoint nikalo, aur woh aadha rakho jis mein sign badal raha hai. Saari iterations neeche table mein hain (bracket mein \(c\) par \(f\) ka sign likha hai).
Kyun: har step interval ko aadha karta hai, is liye \(k\) steps ke baad interval ki lambai \(\frac{1}{2^{k}}\) reh jati hai; root har dafa zyada tang jagah mein qaid hota jata hai.

Rukna kab hai
\[|f(1.92945)| = 0.0002 < 0.0005\]Is liye \(c = 1.92945\) kaafi qareeb hai. 3 decimal places tak round karne se \(x \approx 1.929\).
Kyun: 8.3.1 ka tolerance rule \(n = 3\) ke liye \(|f(c)| < 0.0005\) maangta hai, aur yeh shart ab poori ho gayi.
Dhyan dein: rounding aakhir mein karein, beech mein nahin.

Tasdeeq:
\[f(1.9285) = -0.0252\]\[f(1.9295) = 0.0015\]Dono ke sign ulte hain, is liye LRT ke mutabiq asal root 1.9285 aur 1.9295 ke darmiyan hai, aur is darmiyan ka har number round ho kar 1.929 hi banta hai. Yani hamara jawab pakka 3 decimal places tak sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Find the real roots of the following functions correct to 3 decimal places using the bisection method, within the specified interval of sign change. \(f(x) = x^3 - 3x - 10\) : \([2, 3]\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh wahi function hai jo Example 3 mein bisection se 2 decimal places tak hal hua tha: \(f(x) = x^3 - 3x - 10\), interval \([2, 3]\).
Ab humein 3 decimal places chahiye, is liye tolerance 0.0005 hai, 0.005 nahin.
Pehli 8 iterations Example 3 wali hi hain; hum aage chalte rahenge jab tak shart poori na ho.
Aakhir mein round aur tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = x^3 - 3x - 10\), interval \([2, 3]\).
Maloom karna: root jo 3 decimal places tak sahi ho.
Tareeqa: bisection method. Is ki do shartein hain: function continuous ho aur interval ke dono siron par us ka sign alag ho. Phir hum har dafa interval ko beech se do hisson mein kaat-te hain aur sirf woh aadha rakhte hain jis mein sign badal raha ho, kyunke root wahin chhupa hai. 3 decimal places ke liye tolerance \(|f(c)| < 0.0005\) hai, aur beech ki values 4 decimals tak rakhenge. Yeh wahi function hai jo Example 3 aur Example 4 mein tha; farq sirf itna hai ke ab 3 decimal places chahiye.

Continuity aur sign change check karein
\[f(2) = 8 - 6 - 10 = -8\]\[f(3) = 27 - 9 - 10 = 8\]
\(f(2)\) negative aur \(f(3)\) positive hai, yani \(f(2)\,f(3) < 0\).
Kyun: \(f\) continuous functions (polynomial, sine, cosine) se bana hai, is liye poore interval par continuous hai; graph mein koi toot nahin. Jab graph neeche se upar jaye aur toote nahin to woh x-axis ko kahin na kahin zaroor kaatega. Yahi Location of Root Theorem (LRT) hai.

Iteration 1: \(a = 2,\ b = 3\)
\[c = \dfrac{2 + 3}{2} = 2.5\]\[f(2.5) = (2.5)^{3} - 3(2.5) - 10\]\[= -1.875 < 0\]
Root ab \([2.5, 3]\) mein hai, is liye \(a = c\) rakhenge.
Kyun: midpoint \(c\) par function ka sign wahi hai jo \(a\) par tha (negative), is liye \(a\) ki jagah \(c\) aa jata hai; sign ka badalna ab \(c\) aur \(b\) ke beech hai. Har iteration ke baad interval aadha reh jata hai.

Iteration 2: \(a = 2.5,\ b = 3\)
\[c = \dfrac{2.5 + 3}{2} = 2.75\]\[f(2.75) = (2.75)^{3} - 3(2.75) - 10\]\[= 2.5469 > 0\]
Root ab \([2.5, 2.75]\) mein hai, is liye \(b = c\) rakhenge.
Kyun: midpoint \(c\) par function ka sign wahi hai jo \(b\) par tha (positive), is liye \(b\) ki jagah ab \(c\) aa jata hai; sign ka badalna ab \(a\) aur \(c\) ke beech hai. Har iteration ke baad interval aadha reh jata hai.

Isi tarah aage barhte jayein (table)
Iteration 3 se 11 tak wahi do kaam dohraye gaye hain: midpoint nikalo, aur woh aadha rakho jis mein sign badal raha hai. Saari iterations neeche table mein hain (bracket mein \(c\) par \(f\) ka sign likha hai).
Kyun: har step interval ko aadha karta hai, is liye \(k\) steps ke baad interval ki lambai \(\frac{1}{2^{k}}\) reh jati hai; root har dafa zyada tang jagah mein qaid hota jata hai.

Rukna kab hai
\[|f(2.6129)| = 0.0002 < 0.0005\]Is liye \(c = 2.6129\) kaafi qareeb hai. 3 decimal places tak round karne se \(x \approx 2.613\).
Kyun: 8.3.1 ka tolerance rule \(n = 3\) ke liye \(|f(c)| < 0.0005\) maangta hai, aur yeh shart ab poori ho gayi.
Dhyan dein: rounding aakhir mein karein, beech mein nahin.

Tasdeeq:
\[f(2.6125) = -0.0068\]\[f(2.6135) = 0.0107\]Dono ke sign ulte hain, is liye LRT ke mutabiq asal root 2.6125 aur 2.6135 ke darmiyan hai, aur is darmiyan ka har number round ho kar 2.613 hi banta hai. Yani hamara jawab pakka 3 decimal places tak sahi hai.
